There are wicked people who will
use POKéMON for criminal acts.\pTEAM ROCKET traffics in rare
POKéMON, for example.\pThey also abandon POKéMON that
they consider unpopular or useless.\pThat's the sort of horrid people
they are, TEAM ROCKET.
I think POKéMON can be good or\nbad. It depends on the TRAINER.
